## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle parallel translation by **Divākara** ([地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85)), companion to his own [KR6j0146](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0146) (T969). The title elaborates the *karma-purifying* function of the *dhāraṇī*.

**Abstract**

T970 is Divākara's second translation of the same Sanskrit *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī-sūtra* tradition. The two parallel Divākara translations may reflect successive editorial passes by the translator; together with Buddhapāli's T967, Dù Xíngyǐ's T968, and Yìjìng's T971, they constitute the **five canonical Táng translations** of this most-popular *dhāraṇī*. The translation dates from Divākara's Cháng'ān period (676–688).
